ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; surface area is approximately 95% low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized spots and specular highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark grey/black pigment across both lobes; stochastic distribution of small, high-contrast white circular blobs (pixel clusters) ranging from 1-3% of total fluke area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire margin; prominent jagged peaks at the distal tips; distinct secondary notch on the right lobe lateral margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve along the trailing edge, transitioning from the median notch to slightly convex distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal high-intensity linear disruption on the right lobe, intersecting the medial region; multiple finer horizontal scratches on the left lobe proximal area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notch/indentation on the distal end of the right fluke tip; prominent white linear scar on the right lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Specular highlights (glare) concentrated along the central longitudinal ridge due to water-surface interaction.
